name: com.commencis.appconnect.sdk.iamessaging.InAppMessageActivity
description: When Dataroid AppConnect triggers a standard in-app campaign, this screen displays its text and buttons and carries out choices such as opening a link, copying text, or calling the app's configured button action.
disableEffect: If AppConnect tries to show a standard campaign after this screen is disabled, its direct launch may crash the app and the message cannot appear.
